subject.title: [Bug]: CLI relay exits silently with code 1 when session lane is blocked — no timeout or busy error surfaced

question: Should same-session Gateway-backed CLI dispatches return a terminal lane-busy error after the wait threshold, or keep waiting while surfacing diagnostics?
rationale: The implementation path changes the caller-visible delivery contract and possibly the exit code for blocked CLI dispatches, which is a maintainer product/API choice rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Terminal busy result
options.body: Land or repair the linked PR so CLI callers receive explicit stderr/JSON lane-busy details after the wait threshold, with the exit behavior documented in the PR body.

options.title: Diagnostic-only wait
options.body: Keep queued execution as the default and surface clearer progress or timeout diagnostics without converting the wait into a terminal busy result.

options.title: Replace the draft PR
options.body: Close or pause the current candidate and ask for a narrower replacement once the busy-result contract is decided.

recommendation.title: Terminal busy result
recommendation.body: Land or repair the linked PR so CLI callers receive explicit stderr/JSON lane-busy details after the wait threshold, with the exit behavior documented in the PR body.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision sits on the Gateway-backed CLI relay and queue behavior that Peter introduced and later hardened in the relevant history.
